about: The subject pool. Each subject names one Wikipedia article (the only source the writer may use), the term the clip supplies, the felt experience it opens on, and a footage search. Every term was checked to appear in its article on 2026-10-02.

subjects.angle: You think of the perfect reply an hour after the conversation ends.
You walk into a room sure that everyone noticed the mark on your shirt.
You know the word. You can almost feel it. It will not come.
You learn a new word, and then you hear it everywhere.
A song you did not choose has been playing in your head all morning.
You say a word over and over, and it stops sounding like a word.
You were sure the task would take an hour. It took the whole afternoon.
You look up at the clouds and one of them has a face.
The room is loud, and you still hear your own name from across it.
A song you did not like at first is now one you play on repeat.
